Notify.Resumed: Session Luck Tracker: active session restored, tracking resumed.
Notify.AlreadyActive: Session Luck Tracker: a session is already being tracked.
Notify.NotActive: Session Luck Tracker: no session is being tracked.
Notify.GMOnly: Session Luck Tracker: only a GM can do this.
Notify.Reset: Session Luck Tracker: data of the current session was cleared.
Notify.HistoryCleared: Session Luck Tracker: session archive cleared.
Notify.SessionDeleted: Session Luck Tracker: archived session deleted.
Notify.SessionNotFound: Session Luck Tracker: session not found.
Notify.Error: Session Luck Tracker: something went wrong, see the console (F12).

Chat.StartedBody: Every dice roll counts from now on. May the dice be kind!
Chat.NoRolls: No dice rolls were recorded in this session.

Awards.None: Not enough rolls for awards yet (at least {min} per player).

Table.DeviationHint: Total deviation from 10.5 over all d20 rolls
Table.IndexHint: Universal luck index: mean normalized deviation over all dice (0 = average, ±1 = one standard deviation)
Table.NotEligible: * fewer than {min} rolls: not eligible for Luckiest / Unluckiest

Summary.Outcomes: Degrees of success: {cs} critical success · {s} success · {f} failure · {cf} critical failure
Summary.RankingIndex: Ranking: universal luck index over all dice.

IncludeGM.Name: Include GM rolls
IncludeGM.Hint: Also count dice rolled by GM users. By default only players are counted.

IncludeHidden.Name: Include hidden and blind rolls
IncludeHidden.Hint: Count private, GM-only, self and blind rolls made by players.

IncludeDamage.Name: Include damage rolls
IncludeDamage.Hint: Count dice from damage and healing rolls. Off by default because the d20 is the main luck metric.

IgnoreFlatChecks.Name: Ignore flat checks (PF2e)
IgnoreFlatChecks.Hint: Do not count Pathfinder 2e flat checks.

D20Only.Name: Rank by d20 only
D20Only.Hint: Rank players by their mean d20 result. When disabled, the ranking uses the universal index over all dice.

MinRolls.Name: Minimum rolls for awards
MinRolls.Hint: Players with fewer rolls (d20 rolls when ranking by d20) appear in the table but cannot win Luckiest / Unluckiest.

AnnounceStart.Name: Announce session start in chat
AnnounceStart.Hint: Post a short chat message when tracking starts.

ArchiveSize.Name: Session archive size
ArchiveSize.Hint: How many finished sessions are kept in the archive.

Menu.Name: Sessions and archive
Menu.Label: Open
Menu.Hint: Start or stop tracking, post interim statistics and re-post past sessions.

History.Title: Session Luck Tracker
History.GMOnly: Only a GM can manage luck tracking.
History.ConfirmStopBody: The session will end, be archived, and its statistics will be posted to chat.
History.ConfirmResetBody: All rolls recorded so far in this session will be discarded. Tracking continues.
History.ConfirmDeleteBody: Delete the session from {date}? This cannot be undone.
History.ConfirmClearBody: All archived sessions will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
